Counts presses of a mouse button since the last time MouseHit asked about that button. Use it for clicks that should do one thing and not repeat while the button is held, and [MouseDown](MouseDown) for dragging.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local clicks = 0
While Not KeyHit(1)
	If MouseHit(1) Then clicks = clicks + 1
	Cls
	Text 10, 10, "Left clicks: " + clicks
	Flip
Wend
```
@param button  1 for the left, 2 for the right, 3 for the middle button.
@param device  Only look at this mouse, counted from 0 as in MouseDeviceCount. -1 (the default) means all mice together.
@returns How many times the button was pressed since the last call.
@gap The Device argument is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such argument and only knows one mouse.
